publication.acquisition: Retained complete official added-patch bodies and retained whole maps; no network request. Fullbody Git/SHA/size joins and both complete Merkle roots independently recomputed. Other eleven incoming documents receive identity/preservation credit only.

failureBinding.notTransferred: Original 143/7/179 passing contracts and 114/115 diagnostics do not imply resulting-source lint, UI or runtime success.

independentFindings.finding: Exact current caller supports callback-only identity
independentFindings.evidence: LaunchTeamDialog 1517–1534 instantiates the real owner and 3017 passes capturedReadiness.permits. useCapturedTeamLaunchReadiness 110–118 allocates a fresh permits function each parent render; expiry effect 68–75 uses its unchanged expiry+1 timer to invalidate that parent. The other existing providerStates memo dependencies originate parent props or memo projections of those props.
independentFindings.conclusion: No concrete current-production counterexample requires expanding the observation key to every memo input. The earlier full-key b310 draft is unselected and is not a publication prerequisite. This conclusion does not promise correctness for an arbitrary future permanently stable callback contract.

independentFindings.finding: Render remains pure with the selected local observation
independentFindings.evidence: The selected nullable state contains only callback identity and observed timestamp. A layout effect depends only on the callback, directly samples Date.now when present, and clears absent callback state without a clock read. Render admits the stored observation only for matching current callback identity, after the original loading/scoped-OpenCode short circuits.
independentFindings.conclusion: Child synchronization does not recreate the parent callback; child-only same-callback recomputation reuses the same observed time. No new timer, provider operation, authority cache, global readiness write or changed clock owner is selected.

independentFindings.finding: Action-time and expiry authority stays separate
independentFindings.evidence: providerLaunchAuthority 151–209 keeps createLaunchGuard blockers default now=Date.now and real pure permits; useCapturedTeamLaunchReadiness 124–147 retains captureForSubmit actual-time and current-owner checks. capturedTeamLaunchReadiness requires finite expiry strictly greater than now and exact draft/team/preparation/selection joins.
independentFindings.conclusion: Stored display time cannot authorize a later action. The real existing expiry callback must cause the committed chip to stop showing Ready; no independent continuous wall-clock update contract is added.

independentFindings.finding: Revision 2 is a meaningful regression boundary
independentFindings.evidence: The selected test forces providerStates memo recomputation with a fresh equivalent cliProviderStatusLoading object while holding the actual parent predicate identity. It delegates to the real predicate and separately records presentation timestamps; it then rejects at exact expiry with the actual guard before processing the original hook timer, and processes that timer to observe invalidation.
independentFindings.conclusion: A label-only child update would leave the old memo cached and could pass the old code; the revised test avoids that weakness. Test authoring must retain real owner/fence, original timer, nine captured-readiness cases, existing assertions/mocks and teardown. No test execution or predicted PASS is credited.

independentFindings.finding: The proposed real-owner test needs no provider/preflight call
independentFindings.evidence: createProviderSubmissionFence 210–220 only constructs local latch, UUID and diagnostic map; provider diagnostics are invoked only through its explicit runPreflight method. The selected harness may construct the real fence and seed finite exact proof/context without invoking runPreflight or API operations.
independentFindings.conclusion: No provider execution, mocked substitute expiry owner or broader test framework is required by the published scope.

independentFindings.finding: Existing ESLint setting permits the selected bounded synchronization to be assessed normally
independentFindings.evidence: Current exact eslint.config.js renderer block enables recommended React hooks rules; set-state-in-effect is warning at 720, exhaustive-deps/rules-of-hooks warnings at 713/716, purity remains enforced and actually failed.
independentFindings.conclusion: A possible set-state-in-effect warning is disclosed, not suppressed or presented as lint success. Existing full workspace/types/typed lint and selected renderer suite remain required on actual resulting source; no new mandatory CI cycle is introduced.

lifecycleLimits: Layout-effect state synchronization is intended to resolve the conservative transition before normal paint; this review does not claim that the first DOM commit already has the final chip, that no passive effect can flush, or that a DOM test proves absence of browser paint.

The phrase one bounded synchronization render is a design bound per callback observation, not an exact total React render/setup count. Development StrictMode may repeat setup; no exact count oracle should replace the state/currentness assertions.
An unchanged callback intentionally retains its observation time. Real current parent expiry invalidation, not an added clock or synthetic parent refresh, is the tested mechanism.

The production component is currently 396 lines; the existing 844-line test is retained under its existing guard baseline/exclusions. Actual afterimage size and old-test preservation remain exact-source review obligations; no baseline increase or compression is approved.
preservedValidation: The published two paths already belong to original source freeze/fast operands and existing renderer/type/lint scopes; this review selects no workflow/roster/config change. Actual source must still be independently reviewed and qualify on existing resulting-source commands.
